method: For each physical triple, compare U_i U_ref† with B_i B_ref† up to global phase. This is valid when all circuits in a triple share the same prepared ansatz unitary and differ only by the specified terminal Pauli-basis rotations.
scope_note: This checks mapping/wiring and relative basis changes. It does not validate the H/W matrices, CAP model, state-preparation parameters, or raw-count estimator.
